setup: INSERT INTO web_crawler_requests (date, user_agent, count) VALUES ((now() - interval '40 days')::date, 'OldBot', 100), ((now() - interval '31 days')::date, 'OldishBot', 5), ((now() - interval '29 days')::date, 'RecentBot', 5), ((now() - interval '1 day')::date, 'Googlebot', 30), (now()::date, 'Bingbot', 20)
INSERT INTO web_crawler_requests (date, user_agent, count) SELECT (now() - interval '1 day')::date, 'Bot' || g, g FROM generate_series(1, 205) g
